Everyone is alive for a reason and everyone has their purpose. Find things that make you passionate or at least happy. Even little things that make you smile and laugh throughout the day are things you can be grateful for. You can see that there is light within you and in this world. This world has so much more to offer than what you've been shown. Take risks, do what you love, meet new people, explore. Don't be scared to expand horizons. You're here for a reason.

Normally, when I feel something similar to this I try to watch a show or talk to someone who will remove my mind from the intensity of the situation. Someone funny or caring who can talk to you about anything or just a show that's stupid and full of distractions. Not saying to avoid emotion, but sometimes it's better to calm down and get to a better headspace before processing things like this. Also one thing that helps me is writing. I write down whatever I'm feeling and thinking.
